market_sizing.target_buyer: Founder (early stage) -> Operations Manager / Production Manager (mid stage). FSANZ compliance often a part-time consultant or QA contractor at SMB scale. Family-business buyers common — both spouses involved.
market_sizing.business_count_au: Approx. 1,500-3,500 SMB AU brands in packaged foods + sauces + condiments + spices + dressings (excluding fresh, dairy, meat). AFGC has ~150 corporate members (top of market). Specialty/artisanal long tail visible at Mindful Foods, Find Us in the Forest, Three Threes, Whisk & Pin, Yo Mama's, Saucy Sauce Co, Black Garlic Australia, Spice Tree Organics, etc. ABS food manufacturing SMB count exceeds 5,000 establishments but includes adjacent categories. [uncertain]
market_sizing.business_count_secondary: US: ~20,000-35,000 SMB packaged food brands (Specialty Food Association reports vast market). UK: ~3,000-6,000. NZ: ~400-800. CA: ~2,500-5,000. [uncertain]
market_sizing.typical_size: 2-25 employees, AU$150K-AU$8M annual revenue. Highly fragmented.
market_sizing.annual_revenue_band_aud: 250K-1M most common; secondary cohort at 1M-5M (Growth/Pro tier). Top end at 5M-50M (NetSuite territory).
market_sizing.growth_trend: AU sauces & condiments AU$2B (Statista 2025), 7.12% CAGR 2025-2030. Total AU food & grocery manufacturing AU$102B (AFGC, 288K employees). Premium/artisanal segment growing faster than overall market (~10% YoY). 'Local + craft' tailwind post-COVID.

fit_and_timing.manuva_fit_score: 5 — strong fit. Multi-level BOMs map naturally to recipes + sub-recipes (sauce base -> finished sauce -> retail SKU). Lot tracking + FSANZ recall = core requirement. Co-packer workflows (~30% use co-packers) addressed by location-based inventory.
fit_and_timing.roadmap_dependency: None gating. Xero/MYOB integration boosts close rate (most use Xero). FSMA 204 (US) traceability creates export pressure that benefits Manuva's lot tracking. Amazon FBA connector helps the ~20% selling US via FBA.
fit_and_timing.typical_tier: Starter (AU$99) for kitchen/farmers'-market stage; Growth (AU$249) for retail-distributed brands (AU$500K-AU$3M); Pro (AU$499) for multi-channel + export.
fit_and_timing.regulatory_burden: 4 — FSANZ Food Standards Code, HACCP for export/wholesale, allergen declaration, country-of-origin labelling, state-level food business licensing. Heavy but manageable; SME brands often use HACCP-lite via co-packer.

economics.incumbent_pricing: Craftybase Business AU$199/mo at the artisanal/Etsy end. Cin7 Core AU$349-549/mo at AU$1-5M mid-market. Unleashed NZ$319-399/mo (ANZ legacy). Katana US$199-399/mo. Spreadsheets ~40% of segment at sub-AU$500K revenue. NetSuite at top end (AU$5M+).
economics.willingness_to_pay_aud: AU$249-499 in range. Recall scenarios + retailer (Coles, Woolworths) compliance audits drive WTP. Co-packer brands willing to pay Pro for multi-location.
economics.estimated_arpu_aud: AU$220-280 blended (skew Starter+Growth; smaller Pro tail).
economics.expansion_revenue_potential: 4 — strong Starter -> Growth path once a brand moves from farmers' market to retail. Pro upgrade on multi-channel + export.
economics.churn_risk: 3 — moderate. Food brands fail at higher rates than other CPG (slim margins, retail listings churn). Mitigation: focus on retail-distributed cohort (more stable) over farmers'-market cohort.
economics.cac_estimate_aud: Cash CAC AU$200-500 (LinkedIn + Fine Food Australia + Naturally Good Expo + content + 3PL referrals). Founder-time CAC: ~8-12 hrs per close x AU$100/hr = AU$800-1,200.
economics.ltv_estimate_aud: AU$250 ARPU x 30mo x 78% GM = AU$5,850.
economics.typical_seat_count: 3-12 (founder, ops, kitchen lead, sales, marketing). Per-seat tools painful at 5+.
economics.multi_channel_count: 3-5 (Shopify + Coles/Woolworths wholesale + independent grocers + farmers' markets + Amazon + sometimes Faire). High wholesale mix.
economics.wholesale_b2b_mix: 50-80% wholesale (Coles/Woolies, IGA, independent grocers, food service, Harris Farm, Costco). D2C-pure rare.

Produce Awards. Naturally Good Expo. Foodstarter co-packer marketplace.

where_they_live.podcasts_voices: Foodstarter podcast, Eat My Words (Cynthia Stretch), The Food Process Podcast (US, AU-listened), How Brands Are Built, How I Built This. Voices: Adam Liaw, Kate Berry (Lunch Lady), Foodstarter founders. [uncertain on AU-specific top podcasts]

Naturally Good Expo (Jun, Sydney, ~5K, sponsor AU$8-20K). Foodservice Australia (May/Jun, ~10K). delicious. Produce Awards. Sydney Royal Fine Food Show. ProWein Sydney (adjacent).

outreach_fit.cold_outbound_feasibility: 3 — LinkedIn outbound to ops/founders works. Email findable on most brand websites. Cold phone calls acceptable. Trade-show floor walking at Fine Food Australia is high-yield.
outreach_fit.inbound_content_fit: 4 — 'FSANZ-ready in 30 days', 'Coles supplier audit prep checklist', 'sauce co-packer ops cookbook' converts. YouTube video tutorials fit well (kitchen-style explainer).
outreach_fit.founder_market_fit_proxy: 3 — moderate. Outsider founder OK if pitch leads with software competence + co-packer / retail-readiness framing. NOT a tight insider community like supplements; the artisanal food world is more welcoming to outsiders. Family-business buyers respond to founder-led, plain-spoken comms.
outreach_fit.case_study_acquisition_cost: Medium — 6-10 weeks per case study. Food founders generally enthusiastic about PR (helps retail listings).

foot_in_door_fit.design_partner_appeal: 3 — moderate. Innovator condiment/sauce founders are receptive ('our hot sauce brand needs better ops'). Mid-size brands more conservative.
foot_in_door_fit.paid_pilot_fit: 4 — viable. AU$249 x 3 months works for AU$500K+ brands. Pilots align with retail-supplier mindset ('show me ROI in 90 days').
foot_in_door_fit.free_trial_extension_fit: 3 — 30-day no-card trial brings volume from kitchen-stage tire-kickers. CC-required 14-day for mid-market. Hybrid funnel by tier.
foot_in_door_fit.trial_to_paid_benchmark: Estimated 15-25% blended trial -> paid (mix of opt-in artisanal tire-kickers and CC-required serious mid-market). Paid pilot 40-50%.
foot_in_door_fit.recommended_foot_in_door_motion: Two-track motion. Track A (kitchen/artisanal AU$150K-$500K): 30-day no-card trial + 'Craftybase alternative AU' content + Shopify App Store + Foodstarter community presence. Track B (retail-distributed AU$500K-$3M): founder-led LinkedIn + paid pilot AU$249 x 3 months + Fine Food Australia attendance (walk floor, no booth) + 'FSANZ recall-readiness' cornerstone content. Two case studies in year 1: one artisanal hot-sauce brand, one Coles-supplier mid-market brand.
foot_in_door_fit.rollout_phase: Phase 1 (months 0-3) for artisanal track; Phase 2 (months 3-9) for retail-supplier track once first case studies are live.

competitive_context.current_dominant_tool: Fragmented. Spreadsheets + Shopify ~35-40% at artisanal end. Craftybase ~15% at indie/Etsy end. Cin7 Core ~20% mid-market. Unleashed ~10% ANZ legacy. NetSuite top end ~5-10%. Katana ~5%. Custom tools ~5%.
competitive_context.competitor_gaps_for_this_segment: Cin7 gaps: weak recipe/sub-recipe modeling, post-acquisition pricing rage, no FSANZ-aligned recall export. Craftybase: order-line ceilings, no real production order, weak multi-location for co-packers. Manuva closes: multi-level BOMs with versioning (recipe + sub-recipe + retail SKU), lot tracking + recall genealogy, allocation engine, multi-location for co-packer/co-manufacturer, flat AU$ pricing, Shopify-first depth.
competitive_context.user_satisfaction_signals: r/Foodbusiness threads: 'we outgrew Craftybase but Cin7 is overkill', 'spreadsheets are killing me but I can't afford NetSuite'. LinkedIn AU food-ops posts: 'recall drill last week revealed our lot tracking is a mess'. Foodstarter community echoes pain points.
competitive_context.integration_dependency_list: Must: Shopify (have), Xero/MYOB (roadmap). Important: Coles/Woolworths supplier portals (gap — EDI hard), GS1 barcode generation (gap), HACCP doc storage. Nice: Faire, Amazon FBA, Foodstarter, Australia Post.

partner_channels.xero_myob_partner_channel_fit: 4 — most AU food brands at AU$500K+ have a bookkeeper or accountant on Xero/MYOB. ProAdvisor channel strong once integration ships.
partner_channels.shopify_app_store_acquisition_fit: 4 — artisanal end discoverable via Shopify App Store category browsing.
partner_channels.tpl_3pl_referral_potential: 3 — food-specialised 3PLs (eStore Logistics, Pack & Send food, Aussie Cold Chain) co-sell candidates for chilled/ambient.
partner_channels.industry_association_sponsorship: AFGC corporate membership AU$15-50K (too expensive, and Manuva isn't a 'food company'). Foodstarter community membership low cost. Naturally Good Expo AU$8-20K. Australian Specialty Food Association — modest fees. State-level (FoodSA, FIAL) small sponsor slots AU$1-3K [uncertain].

profitability_math.realistic_12mo_customer_count_solo: 10-20 paying customers in 12 months (two-track motion delivers volume from artisanal track + ARPU from retail track). Funnel: ~400 trial signups + 60 sales convos -> 10-20 paid.
profitability_math.realistic_12mo_mrr_contribution_aud: AU$2,500-5,200 MRR at month 12 (12-18 customers x AU$220-280 blended).
profitability_math.path_to_first_3k_5k_mrr_aud: Sequence: (1) months 0-2: launch artisanal track (Shopify App Store listing + 'Craftybase alternative AU' content + 1 sauce-brand design partner); (2) months 2-4: visit Naturally Good Expo + Fine Food Australia to walk floor and book 20 sales convos; (3) months 4-6: land 1 retail-supplier mid-market customer via paid pilot, ship case study; (4) months 6-9: expand inbound via 'FSANZ recall checklist' cornerstone post + Foodstarter community presence; (5) months 9-12: 12-18 customers. Strong contributor to AU$3-5K MRR floor — pairs well with ceramics for volume and supplements for ARPU.
profitability_math.customers_needed_for_1m_arr_aud: ~360 customers at AU$280 blended ARPU. In aspirational mix, this segment contributes ~100-150 customers (~AU$280-420K ARR) — likely a top-2 contributor alongside supplements. Largest addressable pool of Tier A segments.
profitability_math.solo_founder_bandwidth_fit: 3 — onboarding moderate (recipe BOM setup + lot tracking + retailer compliance config = 6-10 hrs/customer). Support load moderate (FSANZ Q&A occasional). Manageable at 15-20 active customers.
profitability_math.break_even_contribution_months: 2-4 months on cash CAC; 4-6 months fully loaded.
profitability_math.gross_margin_sensitivity: Moderate — recipe BOM complexity occasionally needs hand-holding; co-packer multi-location setup non-trivial. GM ~75-80% with good docs.
profitability_math.priority_ranking: 2 — largest Tier A addressable pool, clear wedge over Craftybase/Cin7, strong reference value (food brands are PR-active), reasonable founder-market fit. Belongs in top 3 alongside cosmetics and pet treats.
profitability_math.risks_and_notes: Risks: (1) Coles/Woolworths EDI integration is the eventual deal-breaker — must address by month 9-12; (2) recall scenarios on Manuva are existential PR risk (same as supplements); (3) food founders churn at higher rates than other segments (slim retail margins) — focus on the AU$500K+ cohort; (4) Fine Food Australia booth is too expensive — must master walk-the-floor + LinkedIn-after motion. Things to verify: actual count of AU food SMBs with Shopify storefronts; AFGC member access for software vendors; whether GS1 barcode workflow is in scope.
